name: Shakunetsu Harem - Arab Migawari no Hanayome
original_name: 灼熱ハーレム-アラブ身代わりの花嫁-
source:
Has the jewel chosen me as the maiden of destiny? As the future queen of this Arabian country, it is your choice who will be the next king…

Should you fail to choose one of the three princes by the next solar eclipse, you will pay with your life. What lies ahead of you, at the hands of such a fate?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.a1a118]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
难道是宝石选择了我作为命运的少女吗？作为这个阿拉伯国家未来的女王，谁将成为下一任国王是你的选择……

如果你在下一次日食之前未能选出三位王子中的一位，你将付出生命的代价。在这样的命运面前，你会面临什么？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.a1a118]谷歌游戏[/url]]
